title: Subscription, limits & billing
public_subtitle: Overview of WinProx Facility, WinProx Time and optional modules. Try free for one month, then choose a plan.
subtitle: After your free month, choose a plan. Limits apply per organisation for units, documents and users; see the FAQ for details.
admin_required: Only an administrator can choose a subscription. Contact your organisation's administrator.
activated: You chose :plan. Your subscription is active for the configured period.
enterprise_hint: Full support for large site operators and complex portfolios. Contact us for a custom quote.
enterprise_contact: Contact us at :email for a custom quote.
status_legacy: Your organisation does not use trial tracking yet (legacy account). All features remain available.
status_grace: Subscription :plan ended on :ended. Grace period until :grace_end — :days days of full access left. Renew in time to avoid interruption.
status_expired: Your trial has ended. Choose a plan below to continue.
pricing_intro: WinProx includes a one-month free trial. After that, choose a plan based on the number of units at your sites (machines, zones, or areas). Optional modules and WinProx Time are listed below.
facility_intro: Plans based on units and team seats. Micro is facility-only; larger plans scale with your organisation.
modules_intro: Add-ons for WinProx Facility (Pro or Business). Monthly surcharge on top of your plan; activation via WinProx.
status_module_esg: ESG module active on your account.
status_module_time: Time module active on your account.
page_limits_units_body: You are using :current of :max units. "Add unit" and "Add location" stay disabled until you upgrade.
page_limits_users_body: You are using :current of :max team seats on your plan (1 administrator plus up to :max staff). "Add user" is disabled until you upgrade.
page_limits_documents_body: Your organisation is using :current of :max documents. Delete a document or upgrade your plan to upload more.
legal_footer_intro: Your account is subject to, among others:

limits.warning_units: You have :remaining unit slots left in your plan.
limits.critical_units: Your unit limit is reached. Upgrade your plan to add more units.
limits.warning_users: You have :remaining user slots left in your plan.

micro.name: Micro
micro.documents: Up to 2 documents per unit · max. 10 for your organisation
micro.description: Ideal for small businesses and compact property managers.

starter.name: Starter
starter.documents: Up to 4 documents per unit · max. 20 for your organisation
starter.description: Ideal for a single site or pilot with a compact coordination team.

pro.name: Pro
pro.documents: Up to 6 documents per unit · max. 40 for your organisation
pro.description: Suited for growing facility organisations with more units and internal teams.

business.name: Business
business.documents: Up to 8 documents per unit · max. 80 for your organisation
business.description: For organisations with multiple sites, many units, and larger teams. Includes API access and webhooks.

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.units: For large site operators and complex portfolios. Contact us.
enterprise.description: Includes API access, webhooks, and custom solutions.

esg.name: ESG module
esg.description: Measurements, indicators, and ESG reporting for your organisation.

time.name: Time module
time.description: Clock in/out, breaks, and shifts alongside your facility management.

time.heading: WinProx Time
time.intro: All-in-one for time tracking with limited WinProx Facility included.
time.name: WinProx Time
time.includes: WinProx Facility micro with Time module included.
time.description: Entry package when time tracking is your focus.
